request: Remove the largest radius that is all around the part and replace it by the same size radius as others. That means in cross section all radiuses will be the same for the profile.

actions.operation: remove/delete the existing largest fillet/round radius feature that runs all around the part
actions.target: the largest radius/fillet that is all around the part
actions.unresolved_reference: confirm that the all-around fillet is the R10 outer edge round set (not the inner corner R50 or the inner-to-step transition with minor R2); confirm whether the 'others' radius to match is R2 (common small blends)
steps: Identify the continuous all-around exterior round by selecting the exterior fillet surfaces in the viewport: the outer long-side round bands and short-side round bands plus the toroidal corner blends (faces 0001/0004/0007/0011 and 0003/0005/0010/0012). Verify these faces form one tangent-continuous loop around the entire outer perimeter in multiple views (top/bottom and isometric).
If the model is history/feature-based: locate the Fillet/Round feature responsible for these R10 exterior rounds (SEC1 outer edge rounds) and suppress/delete that fillet feature.

If the model is direct/editable B-rep (no feature history): use Delete Face (heal/patch) on the selected R10 fillet faces (0001, 0003, 0004, 0005, 0007, 0010, 0011, 0012) with 'Heal' enabled so the adjacent outer wall faces and broad planar faces extend to meet, restoring the pre-fillet sharp edge loop around the outer perimeter.

Regenerate and inspect that the outer perimeter is now a crisp intersection between the outer perimeter skin walls (SEC1) and the broad planar faces (SEC4/SEC5), and that there are no gaps or self-intersections at the four corners.

actions.operation: add a fillet/round (or edit the removed/previous fillet) to apply the same radius size as the other radii in the profile cross section

parameters.radius: R2 (match the existing common small blends called out as minor R2 in SEC3 long-edge fillet bands and the minor radius of SEC2 inner-to-step transitions)

actions.target: the same edges/loop previously having the largest all-around radius (or equivalent edge loop in the profile cross section)
actions.relational_constraint: in cross section, all radii in the profile are equal (uniform radius across the profile)
actions.unresolved_reference: verify the intended 'others' radius is R2 (not R10); confirm whether the requirement applies to both exterior perimeter rounds on both sides (Side A and Side B) and whether any additional edge rounds beyond SEC1 also need to be set to R2 to satisfy 'all radiuses will be the same for the profile'
steps: Determine the reference radius to match from existing geometry: the model description indicates small blends are R2 (SEC3: long-edge small fillet bands R2 cylinders; SEC2: inner-to-step transitions have minor R2). Set the new exterior all-around radius to R2 for uniformity in the cross-section profile.

Create or edit the exterior all-around fillet: select the sharp outer perimeter edge loop created by the previous step (the intersection edges between the broad planar faces Side A/Side B and the outer perimeter wall faces in SEC1). Use tangent propagation to capture the entire continuous loop around the rectangle, including the four corners.

Apply a constant-radius fillet with radius = 2 mm to that complete outer edge loop. Use 'rolling ball' (default) corner treatment so the corner blending remains smooth and continuous through the corners.

Validate continuity and uniformity: inspect the resulting exterior fillet surfaces around the entire perimeter in top/bottom and isometric views to confirm the previous large exterior round (R10) has been replaced by the smaller uniform R2, and that the resulting cross-section radii match the other R2 blends present in the profile.

Final check for intent: confirm that the modified exterior radius does not interfere with the seating/land functionality (SEC3) and that the broad planar datum faces (SEC4 face_code 0028 and SEC5 face_code 0029) remain planar and unchanged except for the edge transition.

intention: Make the cross-section profile radii uniform by eliminating the one largest all-around radius and matching it to the common radius used elsewhere on the profile.
Standardize the exterior edge treatment for consistent manufacturability, appearance, and consistent edge break behavior around the full perimeter.
